name: Harrier's Wood
description: The forest near Strixhaven where the students vanished.

description_citations.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
description_citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Dina announces the class has reached the Harrier's Wood for sample collection.
timeline.quote: We have reached the Harrier's Wood.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Tamira explains that underclassmen may only now visit remote sites because the Oriq have been driven back.
timeline.quote: Now that the Oriq are effectively gone, we can reopen more remote locations for scholarship.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Dina shows the students a snarlflower and sets them to gather six to ten unblemished blossoms each.
timeline.quote: you are each expected to gather no fewer than six and no more than ten unblemished snarlflower blossoms

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Kirol sneaks up on Abigale and startles her, and the two banter about signing and swearing.
timeline.quote: jumping at the sight of the figure behind her, making a hoarse squawking sound at the same time.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Sanar tumbles out of the brush having lost his flowers, and Tamira gives him some of hers.
timeline.quote: That's why I've been gathering extra: you can have a few of mine,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Sanar spots a small blue insect-like faerie in the trees; it laughs and flies off, and he chases it, taking Tamira's basket.
timeline.quote: He leapt to his feet and ran after the fleeing creature—taking Tam's sample basket with him.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: All four students trip over a tree root and tumble into a hole ringed with snarlflowers, falling into prismatic light.
timeline.quote: all four students rolled and tumbled through the leafy debris on the ground, straight into a large hole in the middle of the otherwise unremarkable clearing.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The faerie giggles and dives into the hole after the students.
timeline.quote: giggling wildly, then dove after the students, disappearing into whatever waited on the other side.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Dina leads Liliana and Ajani to the Harrier's Wood to search for the four missing students.
timeline.quote: led the two out of the building where Liliana's office was located and across the fields toward the Harrier's Wood.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Liliana calls up black fog and concludes the students are not dead.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Ajani finds a blue stitched flower petal and recognizes it as coming from a plane where denizens tailor with flowers, which Liliana identifies as Lorwyn.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Ajani refuses to take Liliana along and plans to reach the students through a stable Omenpath between Lorwyn and Shandalar.
timeline.quote: I can't take you with me.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Ajani glows and vanishes to go after the students, and Liliana takes Dina back to campus.
timeline.quote: On the second step, he was gone.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

pages_say.description: A lush forest an hour's walk from Strixhaven campus where the flora is considered magically neutral.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.
